multi_route_union_semantics.path_union: bitwise OR of all selected path masks
multi_route_union_semantics.source_union: bitwise OR of all selected source masks
multi_route_union_semantics.transit_union: bitwise OR of all selected transit masks
multi_route_union_semantics.victim_union: bitwise OR of all selected victim masks

ports.route_legality_uses: canonical static adjacency and valid inter-router directional ports

routing.route_id_equation: route_id = 15 * source_router + (victim_router if victim_router < source_router else victim_router - 1)
routing.route_order: lexicographic ascending by (source_router, victim_router), excluding source_router == victim_router
routing.x_phase: change column one hop at a time until destination column
routing.y_phase: change row one hop at a time until destination row

single_route_masks.path_identity: path = source union transit union victim
single_route_masks.path_mask: contains source, every transit router, and victim
single_route_masks.transit_mask: contains route nodes excluding source and victim
